privacy.title: Data & privacy
privacy.body1: AdFlow reads authorized advertising account identifiers, names, currency, timezone and aggregate campaign, ad group and ad metrics: impressions, clicks, spend and conversions. These power synchronization, calculations, diagnosis and suggestions. Sign-in and advertising authorization are separate. This application does not automatically modify your ads.
privacy.body2: Diagnosis sends the necessary aggregate metrics, ad names and matched benchmarks to the operator-configured OpenAI service. Authorization tokens are encrypted on the server and are never sent to AI. The database stores snapshots, reports and suggestions. Stripe processes payments. When configured, PostHog receives feature-use events. This application does not sell advertising data or use it to train general-purpose models.
privacy.body3: Disconnecting stops synchronization and frees a slot while retaining historical reports. Revoking app access removes locally stored platform tokens and stops related work; you can also revoke platform authorization in Google or Meta settings. Deleting account data removes its application database snapshots, reports and suggestions. Billing records and deployment backups follow the operator’s retention policy.

terms.title: Using AdFlow
terms.body1: Connect only advertising accounts you are authorized to access. AdFlow provides read-only analysis and recommendations for manual execution, without automatically changing budgets, bids or campaigns. Platform availability, attribution settings and reporting delays can affect results.
terms.body2: Review AI output in the context of your business. No specific return or improvement is guaranteed. Industry comparisons use sourced benchmarks with matching definitions. Sample data is not actual business performance or private competitor data.
terms.body3: Monthly subscriptions are tiered by bound advertising account count, with prices shown at purchase. Allowances activate after payment confirmation. Upgrades and downgrades follow the effective dates shown in the interface; disconnect excess accounts when downgrading. Manage renewals, invoices and payment methods through subscription management.

refund.title: Billing & refund support
refund.body1: Use the billing link in your workspace to view payments and subscriptions. Payment results depend on provider confirmation and system processing.
refund.body2: Use subscription management to cancel future renewals and check the effective date. Cancelling renewal and refunding an existing payment are separate actions.
refund.body3: For duplicate charges or other billing issues, contact the operator with your order reference and a description. Refund eligibility follows the operator’s published policy and applicable requirements. This page does not promise automatic refunds.

adflow.aiDisclosure: After connecting, metrics and ad names needed for diagnosis are sent to OpenAI. Please read our data and privacy notice before authorizing.
